uic.common.cancel.description: Generic label of a button that backs out of an action or stops a task

uic.common.confirm.description: Generic label of a button that confirms an action

uic.common.delete.description: Generic label of a button that deletes something

uic.ColorPicker.label.description: Accessible name of a color picker whose caller gave it no label

uic.ColorPicker.hexValue.description: Hidden label of the color picker's text field for a #rrggbb value

uic.ColorPicker.clear.description: Button in a color picker that removes the chosen color

uic.ColorPicker.noColor.description: Shown on a color picker's trigger when no color is set

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting one item

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.titleMany.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting several items; {count} is how many

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.description.description: Question above the list of items about to be deleted

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.targetDescription.defaultMessage: Sei sicuro di voler eliminare definitivamente {target}?
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.targetDescription.description: Question above the list of items about to be deleted; {target} names the kind of item, e.g. Project

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.typeToConfirm.description: Instruction above the confirmation field; {confirmText} is the text to type, shown as a token

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.confirmText.description: The word the user types to confirm deleting several items at once

uic.DeleteConfirmModal.cannotBeUndone.defaultMessage: Questa azione non può essere annullata.
uic.DeleteConfirmModal.cannotBeUndone.description: Warning that the deletion is permanent

uic.NumberStepper.increase.description: Accessible name of the button that steps a number field up

uic.NumberStepper.decrease.description: Accessible name of the button that steps a number field down

uic.SelectionLabel.selectedCount.description: How many items are selected, e.g. rows of a table; {count} is the number

uic.SelectionLabel.clear.description: Button that clears the whole selection

uic.Statistic.unlimited.description: Shown in place of a metric's value when the value has no limit

uic.TokenRow.more.description: After a row of tokens cut short, how many were left out; {count} is the number

uic.UncontrolledInput.label.description: Hidden accessible name of an input whose caller gave it no label of its own

uic.UnitGrid.label.description: Accessible name of a unit grid whose caller gave it no aria-label

uic.UnitGrid.changeGroupColor.description: Button in a unit grid's hover card that opens the palette for the group

uic.UnitGrid.useColor.description: Accessible name of one palette swatch in a unit grid; {index} is its 1-based position

uic.Form.optional.description: Suffix after the label of an optional field when requiredMark="optional"

uic.Form.default.description: Validation error when a rule failed without a more specific message

uic.Form.required.description: Validation error for an empty required field

uic.Form.whitespace.defaultMessage: {label} non può essere un carattere vuoto
uic.Form.whitespace.description: Validation error for a required field that holds only whitespace

uic.Form.typeString.description: Validation error for a value that is not a string; {type} is the type name

uic.Form.typeNumber.description: Validation error for a value that is not a number; {type} is the type name

uic.Form.typeObject.description: Validation error for a value that is not an object; {type} is the type name

uic.Form.typeEmail.description: Validation error for an invalid email address; {type} is the type name

uic.Form.typeUrl.description: Validation error for an invalid URL; {type} is the type name

uic.Form.stringLen.description: Validation error for text of the wrong exact length

uic.Form.stringMin.description: Validation error for text shorter than the minimum

uic.Form.stringMax.description: Validation error for text longer than the maximum

uic.Form.stringRange.description: Validation error for text outside a length range

uic.Form.numberLen.description: Validation error for a number that must equal a value

uic.Form.numberMin.description: Validation error for a number below the minimum

uic.Form.numberMax.description: Validation error for a number above the maximum

uic.Form.numberRange.description: Validation error for a number outside a range

uic.Form.arrayLen.description: Validation error for a list with the wrong number of items

uic.Form.arrayMin.description: Validation error for a list with too few items

uic.Form.arrayMax.description: Validation error for a list with too many items

uic.Form.arrayRange.defaultMessage: Il totale di {label} deve essere compreso tra {min}-{max}
uic.Form.arrayRange.description: Validation error for a list whose item count is outside a range

uic.Form.patternMismatch.description: Validation error for text that does not match a pattern

uic.BulkEditFormItem.keepAsIs.description: Placeholder of a bulk-edit field that leaves every selected item's current value unchanged

uic.BulkEditFormItem.clear.description: Link that clears the field on every selected item, and the field's placeholder once cleared

uic.BulkEditFormItem.undoChanges.description: Link that returns a bulk-edit field to keeping the current values
